components.css: .brick-performance{min-height:280px;display:grid;gap:14px;padding:18px;border:1px solid var(--home-border);border-radius:var(--home-radius-sm,8px);background:var(--home-card-bg);color:var(--home-text)}.brick-performance header{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}.brick-performance header div{display:grid;gap:6px}.brick-performance span,.brick-performance small,.brick-performance p{color:var(--home-text-muted);font-size:12px;font-weight:850}.brick-performance strong{font-size:22px;font-weight:950}.brick-performance nav{display:flex;gap:4px;padding:4px;border:1px solid var(--home-border);border-radius:var(--home-radius-sm,8px);background:var(--home-surface-soft)}.brick-performance button{min-height:28px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:var(--home-button-bg);color:var(--home-button-text);font-size:12px;font-weight:950}.brick-performance main{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.7fr 1.5fr;gap:18px;padding-top:10px;border-top:1px solid #e5edf8}.brick-performance aside{display:grid;gap:8px;align-content:start;padding:4px 0}.brick-performance aside b{font-size:32px;font-weight:950}.brick-performance aside p,.brick-performance .curve p{margin:0}.brick-performance .curve{display:grid;grid-template-rows:minmax(160px,1fr) auto auto;gap:8px}.brick-performance .echart-canvas{min-height:160px}.brick-performance footer{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px;padding-top:8px;border-top:1px solid #e5edf8}.brick-performance footer span{color:var(--home-text);font-weight:950}@media(max-width:720px){.brick-performance main,.brick-performance footer{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

components.css: .brick-wallet-list{min-height:220px;display:grid;gap:14px;padding:18px;border:1px solid var(--home-border);border-radius:var(--home-radius-sm,8px);background:var(--home-card-bg);color:var(--home-text);font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif}.brick-wallet-list *{box-sizing:border-box}.brick-wallet-list header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}.brick-wallet-list header span{color:var(--home-text-muted);font-size:12px;font-weight:850}.brick-wallet-list header strong{color:var(--home-text-strong);font-size:22px;font-weight:950}.brick-wallet-list .wallets{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}.brick-wallet-list article{display:grid;gap:12px;padding:14px;border:1px solid var(--home-border);border-radius:var(--home-radius-sm,8px);background:var(--home-surface-soft)}.brick-wallet-list article span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;min-width:0}.brick-wallet-list article i{width:30px;height:30px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border:1px solid var(--home-border);border-radius:999px;background:var(--home-card-bg);color:var(--home-text);font-size:15px;font-style:normal;font-weight:950}.brick-wallet-list article b{color:var(--home-text);font-size:15px;font-weight:950}.brick-wallet-list article strong{color:var(--home-text-strong);font-size:24px;font-weight:950;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:0}@media(max-width:720px){.brick-wallet-list .wallets{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
